channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro: Pressured as ECB hike looms – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/USD slipped below 1.1600 as the US Dollar strengthened on a hawkish Federal Reserve stance and geopolitical tensions. The team highlights that Euro area inflation has moved back above 3%, reinforcing expectations for a September ECB rate hike.

item.title: ECB's Nagel: Markets see over 95% probability of a September rate hike
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said on Wednesday that markets see over 95% chance of a September rate hike.

item.title: WTI declines to near $89.00 despite US-Iran tensions
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $89.10 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. WTI declines as traders take some profits. However, the potential downside of black gold might be limited amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: Canadian Dollar hits fresh two-week lows amid higher yields, Fed hiking bets
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) depreciates against the US Dollar (USD) for the second consecutive day on Wednesday, weighed by growing risk aversion as global yields rise to multi-year highs and with expectations of an immediate Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike providing additional support to the Greenbac

item.title: BoJ’s Takata says central bank need to consider a broad range of options on monetary policy response
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Hajime Takata said on Wednesday that the central bank needs a different response from conventional semi-annual rate hike pace.

item.title: Indian Rupee holds onto two-month high against US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens flat at around 94.95 against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, but is close to its two-month low of 94.80 posted the previous day.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as Fed rate hike fears lift US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8130 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Gold bounces off four-week low; remains vulnerable near $4,300 amid Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers slightly from a nearly four-week low, which it touched during the Asian session on Wednesday, and currently trades just above the $4,300 mark, still down over 0.50% for the day.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Slides to over one-week low; 0.7125 confluence holds the key
item.description: The AUD/USD pair drops to a one-and-a-half-week low during the Asian session on Wednesday and currently trades around the 0.7135 region, down for the second straight day.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Weakens below 1.1600, further consolidation cannot be ruled out
item.description: The EUR/USD pair loses traction to near 1.1575 during the early European session on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the Euro (EUR) amid hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) stance and escalating Middle East geopolitical tensions.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: New Zealand Dollar moves little following RBNZ Breman’s remarks
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground for the second consecutive day, trading around 0.5840 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Sits near late July high; bulls retain control above 160.00
item.description: The USD/JPY pair touches a fresh high since July 31 on Wednesday, though it lacks follow-through buying and remains below 160.50 through the Asian session.

item.title: British Pound declines to near 1.3500 as US-Iran tensions rise
item.description: The GBP/USD pair declines to near 1.3500 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Ongoing tensions in the Middle East provide some support to a safe-haven currency such as the US Dollar (USD) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Breman Speech: RBNZ Governor sheds light on policy outlook after interest rate hike
item.description: Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s (RBNZ) Governor Anna Breman presents the prepared remarks on the Monetary Policy Review (MPR) and responds to media questions at the press conference after the September monetary policy announcement.

item.title: United States Dollar Index hold gains above 99.50 as Treasury yields hit multi-year highs
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground for the second successive day and trading around 99.70 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $64.00 as inflation fears increase
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $63.40 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The non-yielding Silver declines as a global bond selloff drove the US 10-year Treasury yield up to 4.80%, hitting its highest point since early 2025.

item.title: Australian Dollar surges to July 8 high vs New Zealand Dollar after Aussie GDP, RBNZ
item.description: The AUD/NZD cross builds on the better-than-expected Australian data-inspired gains and rallies to the 1.2200 mark, or the highest since July 8, after the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) announced its policy decision.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar plunges after RBNZ raises OCR by 25 bps to 2.75%
item.description: The NZD/USD pair tumbles to near 0.5855 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) faces some selling pressure against the US Dollar (USD) after the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) interest rate decision.

item.title: WTI advances to mid-$90.00s, fresh high since July 24 amid escalating US-Iran tensions
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – scales higher for the third straight day – also marking the fifth day of a positive move in the previous six – and climbs to a fresh high since July 24 during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises as quarterly GDP grows in Q2
item.description: AUD/USD inches higher after recovering its daily losses, trading around 0.7150 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: BoJ’s Takata says central bank must hike rates mimbly after assessing financial conditions
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Hajime Takata said on Wednesday that the central bank must conduct rate hikes nimbly after assessing accommodation in domestic financial conditions and developments.

item.title: 0.4%: Australia Q2 GDP beats estimates
item.description: Australia’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rose 0.4% QoQ in the second quarter (Q2) of 2026 compared with the 0.3% growth in the first quarter (Q1), the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) showed on Wednesday. This reading came in stronger than the expectations of 0.3% expansion.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7829 vs. 6.7809 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7829 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7809 and 6.7238 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Japanese Yen drops to fresh low since late July vs USD on fiscal concerns and rate gap
item.description: The USD/JPY pair is seen consolidating near its highest level since July 31, touched during the Asian session on Wednesday, and trading around the 160.25-160.30 region.

item.title: British Pound drops as US Dollar strengthens on rising US yields, higher oil prices
item.description: GBP/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 1.3510 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: BoJ’s Ueda says no comment on daily moves, markets price in high likelihood of September rate hike
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda on Tuesday held talks with US Treasury Secretary Bessent on the sidelines of the G20, but giving no details on what was discussed.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Debt expansion is global trend, fiscal policy targeting growth and sustainability
item.description: Japanese Finance Minister (FM) Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday that debt growth is global trend, Japan outlines fiscal policy targeting growth and sustainability. Katayama added that US Treasury Secretary Bessent referenced US strategies to manage debt.

item.title: US military confirms hits Iranian air defence and naval sites
item.description: The US Central Command (CENTCOM) said it completed a wave of strikes against Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targets in Iran early on Wednesday, CNBC reported.

item.title: Gold slumps below $4,350 on higher US yields, hawkish Fed bets
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) tumbles to near a two-week low around $4,330 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure on elevated Treasury yields and a stronger US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Australian Dollar falls as US-Iran conflict lifts USD, GDP data eyed
item.description: The Aussie Dollar retreats some 0.29% against the US Dollar on Tuesday as the escalation of the Middle East conflict boosted the Greenback due to its haven appeal. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7146.
